On this page

Docs-Source Consistency Audit — faultdeck · 2026-11-02 (G3 batch) ​

  • Scope: README.md / README.zh.md / docs/** / todo.md
  • Method: ~/workspaces/standards/文档与源码一致性审计规范.md (three buckets + six steps); every claim evidenced at file:line; negative conclusions verified the search path first
  • Fix direction: source-wins — docs move toward the tree, never the reverse

Key state of the repo ​

The repository currently carries no implementation: no Cargo.toml, no crates/, no examples/, no tests/, no Rust/TS/Go/Python sources (verified by find). The only product surface is the VitePress docs site and the MVP plan. All milestone checkboxes FD-P0-1..6 and every todo.md row are unchecked. The docs are therefore a design-stage surface; findings below judge them as such.

Verified, no action ​

  • README "Repository Layout (target)" is explicitly labeled as target — honest.
  • Status badge "in development / 开发中" describes the overall project (docs/design active); roadmap rows now carry per-phase truth.
  • mvp-plan acceptance gate "100% of faults rolled back" is a hard acceptance spec, not an achievement claim; todo.md "SSH/管理 IP 永不被注入" is a safety invariant — both legal per the copy standard.
  • AI-flavor sweep: no actionable hits (no bragging, no hollow-summary, no tutorial stance; emoji feature icons are vitepress theme config, not markdown decoration).
  • todo.md: 4 uniform unchecked requirement lines with acceptance criteria and prerequisites — already in ledger form, no changes.
  • README badges: license/Rust/backend/platform/status all point at real targets (docs/design/mvp-plan.md, LICENSE); zh badges point at the zh plan page.
